nodes.name: EG reflux reduction
nodes.procedure: Metallic Ir nanoparticles were supported on Nb₂O₅₋ₓ with a loading of 2-60 wt% via an ethylene glycol (EG) reflux reduction process. Sample with 2 wt% loading selected for detailed interface characterization.
nodes.source_text: The Ir/Nb₂O₅₋ₓ and unsupported Ir nanoparticles (Ir NPs) were obtained via an ethylene glycol (EG) reflux reduction process (see Methods for details). Metallic Ir nanoparticles were supported on Nb₂O₅₋ₓ with a loading of 2-60 wt%, as confirmed by varied physical characterizations.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ir nanoparticles form discontinuous contact on Nb₂O₅₋ₓ surface creating quasi Ir shell ≈1 nm thick with epitaxial growth where Ir (200) planes (0.192 nm) match half of Nb₂O₅₋ₓ (001) planes (0.39 nm).
nodes.evidence_snippet: High-resolution high-angle annular dark-field scanning transmission electron microscopy (HAADF-STEM) evidenced that Ir nanoparticles are in discontinuous contact on the surface of Nb₂O₅₋ₓ in Ir/Nb₂O₅₋ₓ, forming a quasi Ir shell with a thickness of ≈1 nm...

Atomic resolution inset showing lattice fringes

nodes.characterization_summary: Powder X-ray diffraction pattern supports particle size statistics and interface structure confirmed by Rietveld refinement.
nodes.evidence_snippet: ...supported by the energy dispersive X-Ray spectroscopy (EDS) line-scan profile (Supporting Information Figure 6), in accordance with the particle size statistics (Supporting Information Figure 7) and Rietveld refinement of the powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD) pattern (Supporting Information Figure 8).

nodes.characterization_summary: FT-EXAFS shows Ir-Ir scattering at ≈2.5 Å for both samples; Ir/Nb₂O₅₋ₓ additionally shows Ir-O at ≈1.5 Å and Ir-Nb at ≈2.0 Å. WT-EXAFS confirms Ir-Nb coordination at ≈10 Å⁻¹. Quantitative fitting gives Ir-Nb bond length 2.43 Å, CN=2.1.
nodes.evidence_snippet: While both Ir/Nb₂O₅₋ₓ and Ir NPs represent a typical first shell predominant peak at ≈2.5 Å in Fourier-transforms (FTs) EXAFS... the Ir/Nb₂O₅₋ₓ demonstrates peak broadening at ≈1.5 Å and ≈2.0 Å... best fitting analysis uncovered a slightly shorter bond length of Ir-Nb (2.43 Å) than metallic Ir, with an average coordination number of 2.1.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ir/Nb₂O₅₋ₓ shows lower electron density on Ir compared to Ir NPs due to Ir-O coordination at interface.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Both Ir 4f XPS spectra (Figure 1f) and X-ray absorption near edge structure (XANES) spectra at Ir L3-edge... demonstrate the lower electron density on Ir in Ir/Nb₂O₅₋ₓ compared with that in Ir NPs...

nodes.characterization_summary: Ir/Nb₂O₅₋ₓ Nb 3d XPS shows decrease in Nb oxidation state consistent with Nb K-edge XANES shift to lower energy.
nodes.evidence_snippet: ...suggesting a decrease in Nb oxidation state after the incorporation of Ir, which is consistent with the Nb 3d XPS spectra (Supporting Information Figure 15).

nodes.characterization_summary: Signals at 3568 and 3510 intensify after Ir introduction indicating Nb⁵⁺ reduction to Nb⁴⁺ and oxygen vacancy formation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Notably, the signals at 3568 and 3510 are intensified significantly after Ir introduction, pointing to the occurrence of Nb⁵⁺ reduction to Nb⁴⁺, accompanied by the formation of oxygen vacancies (Oᵥ).

nodes.characterization_summary: Operando XANES shows Ir/Nb₂O₅₋ₓ initiates oxidation at 0.8 V vs RHE (vs 1.2 V for Ir NPs) and maintains nearly constant Ir valence state at 1.5-2.0 V while Ir NPs show continuous oxidation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Operando XANES spectra at Ir L₃-edge in the wide potential biases between 0.8 V and 2.0 V vs. RHE were collected... Ir/Nb₂O₅₋ₓ initiates Ir oxidation at much smaller potential than on Ir NPs, i.e., 0.8 V versus 1.2 V; (ii) Ir/Nb₂O₅₋ₓ demonstrates a nearly constant Ir valence state at high potential bias...

nodes.characterization_summary: Ir-O bending signal (~330 cm⁻¹) intensity shows Ir/Nb₂O₅₋ₓ requires ~50 mV lower potential than Ir NPs to generate same signal intensity.
nodes.evidence_snippet: By counting the Ir-O bending (≈330 cm⁻¹) signal intensity at different potentials, we found that Ir/Nb₂O₅₋ₓ requires approximately 50 mV lower potential to generate the same signal intensity compared with Ir NPs...

nodes.characterization_summary: Operando Nb K-edge XAS shows Nb valence state decreases with increasing potential until 1.5 V then slowly rises.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Operando Nb K-edge XAS reveals counterintuitive decrease in the Nb valence state with increase in electrode potential until reaching its turning point at about 1.5 V...

nodes.characterization_summary: Quasi in situ O K-edge XAS TEY shows volcanic trend in 4d_t2g-2p peak intensity for O-Nb bond (inversely proportional to Oᵥ content) with apex at 1.5 V.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The 4d_t2g-2p peak intensity for O K-edge XAS in O-Nb bond... represents a volcanic trend with apex sitting at 1.5 V, thus further corroborating the creation of Oᵥ at lower potential and then refilling at higher potential ranges...
